summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 1, 2026, announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary, VersaBank USA, N.A., has partnered with Fiserv, Inc. to provide proprietary digital asset technology and custody services for Bank of North Dakota's dollar-backed stablecoin, Roughrider Coin. VersaBank serves as issuer, handling minting, burning, custody, and reserve asset management; the product is now live on Fiserv's Digital Asset Platform. No stakes, prices, premiums, board recommendations, advisors, or regulatory clocks are stated. This is an ordinary commercial partnership announcement, not a special situation; watch for any future capital, ownership, or strategic implications.
